opus.problem: Matthew 18:24 only says a debtor owing ten thousand talents was brought to the king. The servant begging for patience is in Matthew 18:26, so this part of the clue is not supported by the cited verse.
Matthew is not involved here, but 2 Kings 5:23 does not say Gehazi asked for one talent. That request is in 2 Kings 5:22, so 'not just the one he asked for' is not supported by the cited verse.
